```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2) 
library(ggrepel)

########## Label transfer of mouse to human dataset ##################

#Reference dataset mouse global original, humanised by Alex
load("/g/data/bd20/Ryan/Misc/Label_transfer_object/human_whole_bone_seurat.Robj")

#query dataset human Seurat object
load("/g/data/bd20/Ryan/Relation/031_RRx_OA_only_for_NatGenet/Analysis_13a_OA_cleanest_harmony_multiplet_removed_20250507/RRx_011_to_034_OA_only_cleanest_log_norm_harmony_post_UMAP_annotated_colour_20250512.Robj")

# Convert the metadata column to a factor
RRx_OA_merged_cleanest$Cluster_annotation <- as.factor(RRx_OA_merged_cleanest$Cluster_annotation)

#Assin merged_clusters as the active ident
Idents(RRx_OA_merged_cleanest) <- "Cluster_annotation"

#change default assay to RNA
DefaultAssay(human_whole_bone_seurat) <- 'RNA'
DefaultAssay(RRx_OA_merged_cleanest) <- 'RNA'

#identify common variable features between ref and query
var_features_common <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = list(human_whole_bone_seurat, RRx_OA_merged_cleanest), nfeatures = 3000)

trans.anchors.vargenes <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = human_whole_bone_seurat, query = RRx_OA_merged_cleanest, reference.assay = 'RNA', query.assay = 'RNA', project.query = T, dims = 1:20, features = var_features_common) 

predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = trans.anchors.vargenes, refdata = human_whole_bone_seurat$res.1, dims = 1:20)

#add to meta data to query
RRx_OA_merged_cleanest <- AddMetaData(RRx_OA_merged_cleanest, metadata = predictions)

###### Plot using prediction score matrix ########

# Extract prediction scores (all columns containing "prediction" in metadata)
prediction_columns <- grep("prediction", colnames(RRx_OA_merged_cleanest_diet@meta.data), value = TRUE)

prediction_scores <- RRx_OA_merged_cleanest_diet@meta.data[, prediction_columns]

# Extract cluster identities

Idents(RRx_OA_merged_cleanest_diet) <- "Cluster_annotation"


# Convert prediction scores to dataframe and add cluster identity
prediction_df <- as.data.frame(prediction_scores)
prediction_df$Cluster <- RRx_OA_merged_cleanest_diet$Cluster_annotation

# Compute mean prediction scores per cluster
avg_prediction_scores <- prediction_df %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Cluster")  # Set cluster names as row names




```
